'''Evazan's castle''' was a [[Castle/Legends|castle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] where [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] lived at one point while conducting research on [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]]. The castle was provided to him by an [[Unidentified Andoan senator|Aqualish senator]] of the planet, who hoped to use Evazan's research to bargain with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for the planet's freedom. The structure was on a cliff high above the sea in an isolated area.
